nste01.title: The Question at the Party
nste01.caption: That moment at the party when someone asks if you're seeing anyone. You don't owe a long story: "not right now, and I'm happy" is enough. Then ask about their year.

nste02.title: Decorating for One
nste02.caption: Decorating when it's just you can feel a little pointless. It isn't. You're the one who lives there, so make it cozy for you first.

nste03.title: The Couples Photo
nste03.caption: Ever end up holding the camera because everyone else came as a pair? You're not the extra in the picture. Set the timer and get in the shot.

nste04.title: Soup for Everyone
nste04.caption: Looking after everyone is lovely, until you're eating crackers for dinner. This week, cook for yourself the way you cook for the people you love.

nste05.title: Lights Walk, No Plus-One
nste05.caption: Seeing the lights on your own can feel strange at first. Go for the lights, not the photo. Want a picture? Just ask someone, then return the favour.

nste06.title: The Day Off Plan
nste06.caption: A day off with a 37-step plan isn't really a day off. Rest doesn't need to be finished or checked. Pick one nice thing and let the rest wander.

nste07.title: Nobody to Ask
nste07.caption: No one around to ask which ornament looks better? You don't need a second vote. Start with what you like. Your taste has always been enough.

nste08.title: Just for the Holidays
nste08.caption: When it's cold and quiet, a "just for the holidays" offer can sound tempting. Lonely isn't a reason to say yes. Say what you want, kindly, and wait for real.

nste09.title: Nobody Could Come
nste09.caption: Everyone bailed on the trip? You're good company too. Go anyway, see the thing, and send the view to the friends who couldn't make it.

nste10.title: You Can Cover, Right?
nste10.caption: Being single doesn't make your time spare. Your plans count, even the solo ones. You can still help out on your terms by offering a day that works for you.

nste11.title: The Friend Dinner
nste11.caption: No date this year, and a table full of friends instead. Friendship is a real kind of love. Save this for whoever's hosting your friend dinner.

nste12.title: Movie Night for One
nste12.caption: Crying at a movie, alone, under a blanket, and loving every minute. Feeling things on your own still counts. Your own company can be the coziest plan.

nste13.title: Skating Solo
nste13.caption: Trying something new with nobody to hold onto is scary. Hold the rail, that's what it's for. Fall, laugh, try again. You can be your own steady.

nste14.title: A Gift for Me
nste14.caption: Buying yourself a little gift can feel silly. It isn't. Keep it small, kind and in budget, then wrap it properly. Yes, you get a bow too.

nste15.title: Nine Hellos
nste15.caption: Lots of hellos and still lonely? Quick texts don't always fill the gap. Pick one friend and actually call. One real conversation goes a long way.

nste16.title: Everyone Paired Off
nste16.caption: When your friends pair up, it's easy to quietly drift home. Your friends still want you around. Say what you miss out loud and ask for the plan you want.

nste17.title: No Dance Partner
nste17.caption: A slow song, no partner, and a mug to hold. The dance floor takes singles. Dance with your friends, or just the beat, like the song is yours.

nste18.title: The Set-Up
nste18.caption: A friend has someone "perfect" for you, and you're not ready. Thank them, be clear and stay kind. "Not yet" is a kind answer.

nste19.title: Know Your Yes
nste19.caption: Not sure what you want in a partner? Single time is a great time to find out. Write down your yeses and your dealbreakers before you need them.

nste20.title: The Invite
nste20.caption: Invited to someone's family dinner and worried you'd be in the way? They asked because they want you there. Letting people in is allowed.

nste21.title: The Midnight Hug
nste21.caption: Worried about having no one to hug at midnight? Midnight hugs come in friend sizes. Make a plan with the people you love and hug whoever shows up.

nste22.title: The Year You Built
nste22.caption: Think nothing happened this year because you stayed single? Look again. New skills, new friends, small brave moments. You built a lot.

nste23.title: Curious Again
nste23.caption: Happy on your own and starting to feel curious? That's a good sign. Ready feels like curious, not lonely. Go slow and let the conversation come first.

nste24.title: The Thriving Party
nste24.caption: Single isn't a waiting room. It's a life, and it's worth celebrating out loud. Tag the friends who'd be first through the door at your thriving party.
